description: This file defines the VerifyPickSession class, which manages the process of verifying and processing pick items within a shipment verification workflow in an Apache OFBiz-based system. It includes methods for creating pick rows, checking inventory reservations, issuing items to shipments, and completing verification, encapsulating the logic necessary for pick verification during order fulfillment.

classes.name: VerifyPickSession
classes.description: This class manages the session for verifying pick items in the shipment process. It includes methods for creating pick rows, checking inventory reservations, issuing items to shipments, completing the verification process, and updating related product data.

methods.name: VerifyPickSession
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session with dispatcher and user login.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Lazily retrieves the LocalDispatcher instance associated with the session.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Lazily retrieves the Delegator instance used for database operations.

methods.name: createRow
methods.description: Creates a verify pick session row for a specific order item, reserving inventory if available, or throws exception if not.

methods.name: findOrderItemSeqId
methods.description: Finds the order item sequence ID based on product, order, and quantity.

methods.name: checkRowForAdd
methods.description: Checks if the reservation can hold the requested quantity and updates the verify pick row accordingly.

methods.name: createVerifyPickRow
methods.description: Adds a new VerifyPickSessionRow to the session based on the check outcome.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Returns the user login info.

methods.name: setFacilityId
methods.description: Sets the facility ID for the session.

methods.name: getFacilityId
methods.description: Returns the facility ID.

methods.name: setPicklistBinId
methods.description: Sets the picklist bin ID.

methods.name: getPicklistBinId
methods.description: Returns the picklist bin ID.

methods.name: getPickRows
methods.description: Returns all pick rows in the session.

methods.name: getPickRows
methods.description: Returns pick rows filtered by specified order ID.

methods.name: getReadyToVerifyQuantity
methods.description: Calculates total quantity ready for verification for a specific order and order sequence.

methods.name: getPickRow
methods.description: Retrieves a specific pick row matching given identifiers.

methods.name: getVerifiedQuantity
methods.description: Calculates total quantity verified so far for specific order details.

methods.name: clearAllRows
methods.description: Clears all pick rows from the session.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Completes the pick verification process: checks quantities, issues items, updates products, creates shipment, and updates shipment status.

methods.name: checkReservedQty
methods.description: Verifies that total verified quantities match reserved quantities for each order item.

methods.name: getReservedQty
methods.description: Retrieves the total reserved quantity for an order item and shipment group.

methods.name: checkVerifiedQty
methods.description: Ensures total verified quantities match ordered quantities; throws exception if not.

methods.name: issueItemsToShipment
methods.description: Issues verified items to the shipment, grouping by item for efficiency.

methods.name: checkLine
methods.description: Checks if a pick row has already been processed and sets shipment item ID if so.

methods.name: createShipment
methods.description: Creates a new shipment record based on a pick session line, returns shipment ID.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates product information based on pick verification (e.g., origin geo ID).
